answer: Jetty-quorum voyage bond: each identity locks 70 in a vault, naming one jetty. Each epoch five jetty neighbors co-sign its voyage log at 12 each, one log per neighbor. A shared key in a quorum burns all six bonds. 1,000 fakes need 5,000 neighbors at 82 each (70 bond, 12 stake): 410,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. Rented neighbors share one key, so the rented ring burns. An honest agent pays 70 once, stakes 12 per epoch, refunded if clean.
